value.text: Diarrhoea about four to six watery stools a day, much the same for ten days. Tiredness and breathlessness have built up gradually over several weeks.

release_text: Diarrhoea about four to six watery stools a day, much the same for ten days. Tiredness and breathlessness have built up gradually over several weeks.

rationale: The article gives 10 days of watery diarrhoea and asthenia. An Hb of 51 g/L with MCV 113 fL develops over weeks to months, so the tiredness predates the diarrhoea. Stool frequency is not reported; moderate frequency fits stable haemodynamics.

value.text: Oral rehydration solution at home; no other treatment.

release_text: Family noticed her eyes looked yellow over the past week or so.
lay_text: My family said my eyes have looked yellow this past week or so.
rationale: Article: noticeable jaundice on examination (E03). Unconjugated bilirubin 31 umol/L is visible as scleral icterus; a relative noticing it is the usual history.

value.text: Urine perhaps a little darker yellow than usual; never red, brown or cola-coloured.

release_text: Urine perhaps a little darker yellow than usual; never red, brown or cola-coloured.

value.text: No abdominal pain.
